Use case: stylized-concept. Production animation artwork, hand-painted smooth full-color fantasy illustration, NO pixel art, NO pixelation, NO dithering. Reference image 1 is character identity reference: ONLY the leftmost blonde swordswoman Cookie. Preserve her exact round-6 face, blonde wavy bob, proportions (roughly four heads tall), blue gold-embroidered shoulder/tunic armor, silver breastplate, red waist sash hanging at her far hip, brown buckled belt and pouch, cream leggings, tall brown ornate folded-cuff boots, silver single-handed sword with gold ornate crossguard. No other characters. Camera and body always face screen-right in the same three-quarter view. Sword always held in the SAME near/right hand (the gauntleted arm on screen-left side of torso in reference); free far/left arm NEVER crosses chest. Near leg lit; far leg one shade darker, including its boot. Consistent anatomy, face, limb length, costume and sword length in every frame. Genuine transparent alpha background, no ground shadows, no floor, no labels, no specks. Generous margins keep full swords and feet within each cell. Keep one identical scale across every frame: do not resize individual poses to same height. Character neutral crown-to-sole height is 360 source pixels; ground lines uniform within each row. Supply a clean regular contact sheet for extraction.
Create IDLE animation sheet, exactly 4 full-body frames in ONE horizontal row, equal cells. Natural combat ready stance with feet planted apart and knees softly bent. Sword held low diagonally forward/down, tip near ground but not touching. All four frames have IDENTICAL planted boot positions. Frame 1 baseline breathing posture. Frame 2 inhale: chest/shoulders rise 4.5 source pixels (1 pixel at game 80px), sword tip slightly rises; hair and red sash trail one frame late. Frame 3 peak inhale, chest held up without exaggerated movement. Frame 4 exhale symmetric with frame 2, settling toward frame 1; hair tips and sash gently lag. Breathing is subtle, not a walk, no lifted feet. Carefully preserve the reference character. Frame 1 will also be attack recovery frame 8.

Refine ONLY the subtle breathing in this 4-frame idle sheet, preserving exactly this same character, face, body proportions, costume, sword, paint texture, planted feet and transparent background. No pixel processing. Four equal cells in one row. Frame1 stays exactly unchanged. Frame2 currently chest and crown rise about 16 pixels; reduce this rise to just 9 pixels versus frame1, by breathing posture, with feet identical and same head size. Frame3 is peak inhale 12 pixels above frame1. Frame4 is the exhale midpoint with chest/crown 9 pixels ABOVE frame1, symmetric with frame2; don't make frame4 identical to1. Very slightly raised sword tips in2/3/4 follow breathing. Hair ends and sash follow with one frame delay, tiny movement only. All feet remain exactly stationary and knees same, don't walk. Keep everything else identical, no body scaling. Genuine zero-alpha clear background without semitransparent color haze or specks.

Create WALK animation: EXACTLY 8 full-body poses in a 4 columns x 2 rows regular grid, read left to right then bottom row. Maximal quality smooth character painting. The sword is low pointing diagonally forward/down throughout, swing from shoulder only +/-10 degrees. Free FAR arm swing +/-30 degrees must be clearly visible OUTSIDE the torso silhouette, forward on frame1 and backward on frame5. Legs alternate visibly, near boot brighter than far boot. Gait eight distinct poses:
1 CONTACT NEAR leg ahead toward screen-right heel touching ground, far leg stretched BACK screen-left toe touching. Max stride. Far empty arm forward +30 degrees, near sword arm back -10 degrees.
2 DOWN NEAR leg supporting, front knee bends absorbing weight, far heel lifts behind. Chest AND head lower 2px at 80px scale (2.5% body height) through knee bend, not smaller drawing. Far arm +20deg, sword arm -7deg. Hair tips and red sash float UP from prior motion.
3 PASS near leg straight under hips supporting, far knee/foot passes under hips toward front, legs nearly overlap. Both arms pass downward at body's sides. Baseline head height.
4 UP near leg extends standing on ball/toes, FAR knee lifted forward, far foot off ground. Whole body 1.5px at 80px scale ABOVE baseline. Far arm begins backwards -20deg, sword arm forward +7deg. Hair ends and sash hang lower, delayed.
5 CONTACT opposite: DARK FAR leg now forward heel at screen-right, BRIGHT NEAR leg extended BACK toward screen-left toe planted. Max stride. Far empty arm BACK -30deg visibly behind shoulder, near sword arm forward +10deg. This MUST NOT duplicate frame1 legs.
6 DOWN far leg supporting, front far knee bends, near heel lifts behind. Head and chest 2px below baseline. Far arm -20deg; near sword arm +7deg. Hair/sash lifted slightly.
7 PASS dark far leg supports under hips; bright near knee passes forward under hips, legs almost overlap. Arms down at sides. Baseline height.
8 UP far supporting leg extended on ball/toes, NEAR knee lifted forward, foot airborne, head/chest 1.5px above baseline. Far arm starts forward +20deg, sword arm back -7deg. Hair/sash lag downward.
One frame delayed hair/sash, subtly pitching torso. Same face and body size. No costume changes. No floor. No captions. Show readable actual arm motion, not just leg changes.

Edit this eight-frame Cookie walk animation sheet. Preserve the exact same illustrated character identity, face, hair, costume, boots and sword. Smooth painted art, NO pixel art. Four columns two rows.
CRITICAL corrections:
1. Remove ALL brown background/glow/shadow completely, deliver truly empty transparent alpha=0 outside character silhouettes. No haze, no floor, no backdrop.
2. Bottom row must be the OPPOSITE LEG PHASE of top row. In frame5 (bottom left), the nearer brighter leg is BEHIND to screen-left and darker farther leg is IN FRONT toward screen-right. Frame6 front far knee bends. Frame7 near leg passes front while far leg supports. Frame8 NEAR knee raised in FRONT and FAR leg supports. Do not just duplicate the top row.
3. FREE FAR ARM in frames4,5,6 swings BEHIND body, fist visible screen-left behind back, about30 degrees backward, NEVER crossing chest. Frame1 free fist forward screen-right about30 degrees. Frame2 a little less forward. Frames3 and7 free arm hangs straight down. Frame8 begins swinging forward.
4. Near sword arm swings only10 degrees opposite its near leg; retain same hand. Sword points diagonally downward screen-right.
5. Ground baseline identical in each row. CROWN heights relative to ground for frames1..8 MUST be 470,458,470,479,470,458,470,479 pixels respectively through knee bend or extension; no changes in head size or body part lengths. This is contact/down/pass/up x2.
6. Keep hair and sash one frame behind body bounce: hair/sash tips elevated on2/6, hanging lower on4/8.
The character retains round6 cream leggings on BOTH legs, far leg shaded darker brownish cream, not bare skin. Exact eight poses. Full body and weapons fully inside equal cells, no labels.

Create a professional 8-frame walking cycle sheet. Input1 is DESIGN: use ONLY leftmost blonde swordswoman Cookie with her exact face, wavy blonde bob, blue gold tunic, silver chestplate, cream leggings, brown high boots, red sash, ornate silver sword. Input2 is the mandatory POSE blueprint, not visual style. Translate all eight skeletons faithfully into this SAME hand-painted character, four columns two rows. Gold skeleton limb=near lit limb; navy skeleton limb=far darker limb; do NOT paint limbs gold/navy, use normal costume colors and light/shade. Head size and limb lengths stay constant; match skeleton heights and foot placement, every support foot on row baseline. Frames1-4 near leg supports; frames5-8 far leg supports. The near leg is forward at1 but backward at5. Far empty arm extends FORWARD at1, BACKWARD at5. Follow both arms' guide paths exactly. Near hand MUST stay attached to sword hilt, small arm swing only, blade low diagonal forward. Empty far arm is behind torso when swinging back, never over chest. Slight head/chest bob from guide, knees bent on2/6, body high on4/8. Hair and sash lag by one frame. Face always right3/4, never mirrored. SMOOTH detailed painted art, NOT pixel art. Transparent background, no backdrop, no brown haze or glow, no shadows, no floor, no text or visible guide. EXACTLY eight separate characters evenly spaced, weapons fully inside cells.

Correct this walking sheet, preserving its exact character design and smooth painterly quality. Keep 4x2 layout, same 8 frames. Camera MUST NEVER rotate: all frames show SILVER FRONT BREASTPLATE in same right-facing three-quarter view as frame1. IMPORTANT: frames5 and7 wrongly show the BACK of the blue tunic: replace those torsos with the FRONT silver breastplate angle from frame1, without changing their gait phase. Keep sword in near/right hand, located on the screen-LEFT side of chest/hip in EVERY cell. Never swap hand or reverse torso. In frames5 and6 the empty FAR arm swings backward toward screen-left behind body, with its dark gloved fist peeking behind the near elbow; the near sword hand remains at near hip and swings only slightly forward, blade down-right. In frame5 BRIGHT NEAR leg extends BACK to screen-left and DARK FAR leg extends FORWARD to screen-right. In6 DARK FAR leg supports with bent knee, BRIGHT NEAR leg trails. In7 DARK FAR leg supports straight under hips, BRIGHT NEAR knee passes under hips, feet almost overlap; both arms down. Frame8 DARK FAR supporting leg down, BRIGHT NEAR knee raised ahead; free far arm forward. Frames3/7 are passing poses with feet almost overlapped, not long strides. Use a clearly darker value for far boot and leg in ALL frames, preserving their actual brown/cream costume colors. Preserve remaining correct poses, body height bob and same foot ground line. Preserve transparency. No labels or shadows.

Supporting reference image 2 is the completed idle sheet. Match its exact character face, clothing, scale. Make ATTACK animation EXACTLY 8 full-body drawings in 4 columns x 2 rows grid. Consistent camera right-facing 3/4, same right/near sword hand every frame. Exactly ONE downward overhead sword slash, NO reverse slash and no second sword raise after impact. Read left to right then bottom row.
1 READY/LOAD: same low sword ready stance as idle reference frame1, but weight moves onto rear foot and near sword arm pulls slightly backward. 60ms.
2 WINDUP: right sword hand lifted above and BEHIND head, sword raised high behind crown, torso leans back. 80ms.
3 WINDUP PEAK HOLD: lean back a little MORE than frame2, lift FRONT foot to prepare a strong step, sword overhead/back, free arm balances naturally without crossing chest. 140ms.
4 SWING MIDPOINT: overhead sword sweeps FORWARD through descending arc. Exactly ONE soft translucent blur arc following blade, no duplicate blades, no multiple action lines. Front foot stepping. 40ms.
5 IMPACT HOLD: long planted forward step screen-right, bent front knee, torso leans strongly forward into strike. Extended sword points forward screen-right just BELOW HORIZONTAL about 10-15 degrees down. Clear long reach. 150ms.
6 FOLLOW THROUGH: same sword swings to finish fully DOWN toward front ground at steep downward diagonal, torso low forward, hair and red sash fly FORWARD screen-right one frame late. 90ms.
7 RECOVER: body rises upright, HAND draws inward toward lower chest, blade still pointing DOWN with tip kept low; no overhead lift, no upward-pointing blade, no fresh attack windup. Rearward retraction of hilt only. 90ms.
8 RETURN: EXACT idle reference frame1 pose: planted feet, upright combat ready, near sword hand low beside hip, blade diagonally down/forward. 80ms.
Allow ample empty room above frames2/3 for full sword and right of frames4/5 for reach. Same boots and ornate gold sword throughout. Preserve body proportions, no facial or costume drift. Never swap holding hand.

Background extraction and contact sheet spacing correction. Keep these EXACT eight swordswoman drawings with all facial features, clothing, anatomy, painted colors, sword poses and soft sword arc unchanged. Completely REMOVE the brown/black glowing background. Output pure transparent empty background, alpha=0 outside the actual character and sword silhouettes. No matte, haze, glow or shadows. Arrange the eight cutouts in equal four-columns two-rows cells with generous horizontal spacing so every sword fits entirely within its own cell and NO sword touches or overlaps another character. Use the SAME scale for all 8 drawings; if more space needed enlarge canvas. Do not change poses or repaint characters. Preserve soft translucent sword arc only in4 (top right). Keep the actual characters opaque.

Render FOUR consecutive walking poses in one horizontal row using reference1's EXACT blonde swordswoman design. Reference2 is a limb-position guide for frames5,6,7,8 of the cycle. Same silver front breastplate facing screen-right three-quarter view ALL FOUR. Belt POUCH ALWAYS SCREEN-LEFT, RED SASH ALWAYS SCREEN-RIGHT, sword-holding silver-gauntleted RIGHT arm ALWAYS SCREEN-LEFT edge of torso. These landmarks must NEVER swap. Same face, blonde bob, blue-gold tunic, cream leggings, brown boots, proportions and silver/gold sword as reference.
FOUR poses:
5 DARK FAR leg stepping FORWARD SCREEN-RIGHT, BRIGHT NEAR leg stretched BACK SCREEN-LEFT. Front leg and front boot must be notably DARKER than trailing leg/boot. Far empty arm swings backward behind body toward screen-left, with its fist visible slightly left of sword elbow. Sword hand at near hip, blade down-right. Same front-view breastplate.

Make only two precise local corrections to this four-frame walking sheet. Preserve everything else exactly, including face, hair, armor, sword, poses of frames1,2,4, limb placement, scale, alpha transparency and layout.
A. First and second characters have a wrong CREAM boot on the leg extended toward SCREEN-LEFT. Repaint ONLY the boot material from knee cuff down through the toe to BROWN LEATHER matching this character's other boot design, with gold ornament and a brown folded cuff. Keep it more brightly lit than the farther DARK BROWN boot, but still unmistakably brown leather; do NOT repaint the cream fabric thigh above the cuff. Same brown boots on all characters.
B. Third character's moving bright knee is lifted too high for passing: lower that knee/foot toward directly beneath the pelvis, with thigh closer to vertical and foot passing beside the planted far ankle, slightly lifted off ground. Keep head/chest and planted dark support leg unchanged. Fourth character retains its high knee UP pose.
No other changes. No added background.

Render FOUR consecutive walking poses in one horizontal row. Input1 is the exact character design, ONLY the leftmost blonde swordswoman Cookie. Input2 is pose blueprint for frames1,2,3,4. Input3 shows the matching second half of same cycle: match its face, paint quality and proportions. Maintain front silver breastplate facing right3/4 in all frames; brown pouch SCREEN-LEFT, red sash SCREEN-RIGHT, sword in near/right silver-gauntleted hand SCREEN-LEFT of torso, NEVER swap. Cream leggings above BROWN ornate knee-high boots, both boots brown, far boot darker one shade.
1 CONTACT: bright NEAR leg reaches forward screen-right heel touches ground; darker FAR leg extends behind screen-left toe touches. Maximum stride. FAR empty arm reaches forward screen-right30degrees, near swordarm back10degrees, sword low down-right.
2 DOWN: bent front NEAR knee absorbs weight; far heel lifts behind. Head/chest descend exactly2.5% of baseline crown-to-ground height through knee bend. Empty arm stillforward20deg, swordarmback7deg.
3 PASS: NEAR supporting leg straight beneath hips, FAR knee/foot passes just under hips, feet nearly overlapping, both arms down. Baseline headheight.
4 UP: NEAR supporting leg extends standing on ball/toes, FAR knee raised forward; crown/chest rise only1.9% above baseline. Empty arm starts backward20deg with fist peeking screen-left behind sword elbow; near swordarmforward7deg. Sword always gripped.
Hair/sash lag one frame; on2 hair/sash tips lifted, on4 hanging lower. ONE scale, fixed row groundline. Detailed smooth painted character, no pixel art, no labels, no floor. Real transparent alpha background. Ample margin above heads and around complete swords, four evenly spaced figures.

Precise local edit to this four-frame walking sprite sheet. Change ONLY the SECOND character:
- The rear boot at screen-left is erroneously cream/white. Restore its entire calf/cuff/foot to DARK BROWN ornate leather, exactly the same boot design as other frames. Far leg/boot one shade DARKER than supporting front near leg/boot. Keep cream fabric thigh above cuff.
- Compress this character's stance by bending her FRONT SUPPORTING knee more and sinking pelvis/chest/head DOWN by exactly 17 pixels relative to the unchanged planted front sole. Keep body part proportions and head size; do not scale image or move feet. The body height of frame2 should be2.5% shorter than1 due knee bend, NOT resizing.
- Slightly raise hair tips and red sash to lag the downward body movement.
First, third and fourth characters MUST remain unchanged. Preserve exact face/costume, sword in same hand, and transparent background. NO pixel art.

Refine ONLY the SECOND character's down pose. Image1's second character bends too deeply; image2's second character does not bend enough. Draw an INTERMEDIATE pose: keep only ONE THIRD of the downward displacement seen in image1 relative to image2. In other words straighten the front supporting knee slightly to lift pelvis/chest/head about30 source pixels relative to image1, while keeping the planted foot stationary. Keep the dark brown rear boot from image1. Do not restore the cream boot error in image2. Keep exactly the same face, head size, torso proportions, sword grip and costume. First, third and fourth characters of image1 unchanged. Same four-cell sheet, smooth painted style, transparency. No changes except second character becoming less deeply crouched, about one-third current crouch depth.

Edit ONLY the FIRST character in this four-character idle sheet into a sword recovery pose. Keep her face, hair, torso size, leg lengths, boots, planted foot positions, costume, camera and scale EXACTLY unchanged. Bend the near/right sword elbow so the same sword hand draws inward to LOWER CHEST height, while sword blade points steeply DOWN and slightly forward screen-right, its tip stays low near the existing sword tip height. This is recovering after a downward cut, not raising for another attack. Keep shoulders upright relaxed, legs softly bent exactly like current idle. No sword above chest, no extra arms, no second blade. Far empty hand relaxed at her far side. Preserve the other three characters unchanged. Exactly same four-cell sheet and transparency. No change in character height. Smooth painted art, no pixelation.
